description: This file defines the CustomerApproval controller class in the OpenCart admin module, handling customer approval workflows such as listing, approving, and denying customer approval requests within the admin interface.

classes.name: CustomerApproval
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer approval requests, including listing, approving, and denying customer approval applications in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares data and renders the customer approval listing page in the admin interface.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the process of fetching and returning the list of customer approvals.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the customer approval list based on current filters and pagination.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Processes approval of selected customer or affiliate applications based on provided IDs.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Processes denial of selected customer or affiliate approval applications.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Processes denial of selected customer or affiliate approval applications, including fetching approval info, performing denial actions based on type, and returning JSON response.
